gaps.what: No dossier written: the row is merged into antigonid-dynasty, which eu-02-a wrote with both Names in cliopatria_names and all 18 antigonid-macedonia shapes reviewed (26 keyframes, validates).

The row is an aggregate of independent poleis, not a state; all six events are confidence 1; the West Pontic, Olbia, Crimean, Cretan, Iberian and Propontic clusters and the Colchian, Elean and Carian cell changes are unverified.
No page gives the extent for 256-248 or 227-197, the land rewarded in 196, Pharos and Issa, or the Second Illyrian War (220-219); founding date unknown (256 is Cliopatria's year).
Mainland holdings of 408-189 and the end of Rhodian self-rule (39 is a bridge) are on no page; the date of the tributary remainder of Caria and Lycia is ambiguous.
No page dates the Roman sack of the Molossis (seventy cities, 150,000 enslaved) or gives a Molossian frontier or area; kingdom-of-epirus dates the fall to 167 from a page not opened here.
Kept unchanged from an earlier run; its own notes list the undated accessions and Roman-settlement terms left at confidence 1 or omitted.
